App details

Last Done

Remember when you last did a recurring task and when it is due again.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Record a recurring task with one tap, see when it was last done and its history, and optionally set intervals, reminders and a due-date countdown.

Main features

  • Record completion with one tap.
  • See past completions and elapsed time.
  • Choose repeat intervals and optional reminders.
  • Organize tasks into categories.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Create an item such as watering a plant or changing a filter, then tap Done now when you finish. Its last completion and elapsed time become visible. Set an optional interval to see the next due date, add an older completion manually, and use categories or archive items you no longer need.

Important limits

Due dates follow the interval you enter, not a learned prediction. Reminders are optional and depend on Android notification settings. Shared lists, team projects and location-based reminders are not planned.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Optional reminders may need notification permission. The basic completion log needs no location, camera, microphone or contacts.

Local data

Item names, categories, intervals, completion history and reminder choices would stay locally. System backup or device transfer is separate from JN86 cloud sync, which is not planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

The first version includes completion history and optional reminders. Automatic learning of schedules and shared cloud lists are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
